premise: Astronomer always looks up and Geologist always looks down, until they bump; he shows her the sparkles in the dust, she shows him the comet.
inspiration: La Fontaine's 'The Astrologer Who Fell into a Well' (after Aesop), turned: nobody falls — they bump, and swap views.
lesson: Two ways of looking are better than one.
learning: Moon dust is full of tiny glass beads that sparkle in the light.

en-US.title: Up and Down
en-US.text: {astronomer:enter} Astronomer always walked with her eyes on the sky. {astronomer:live} Binoculars up, pointing at stars. {geologist:enter} Geologist always walked with his eyes on the ground. {geologist:live} Hammer tapping, peering at rocks. {rover:enter} Rover was drilling nearby when {rover:live} it saw what was coming. {rover:pulse} Beep. Beep. BEEP! {sfx:bonk} Bonk! Helmet met helmet. {astronomer:face surprised} {geologist:face surprised} [giggles] Sorry! Sorry! Then {geologist:pulse} Geologist pointed down. {canvas:glints 12s} Look! The dust sparkled. Moon dust is full of tiny glass beads, he said, made long ago when rocks from space melted it. {astronomer:face happy} {canvas:comet 14s} Astronomer pointed up. And look at that! A comet was gliding over. {geologist:face happy} [gasps] Ooh… So from then on they walked together: one looking up, one looking down. {rover:hop} And Rover, beep, beep, looked where they were going.

es-ES.title: Arriba y abajo
es-ES.text: {astronomer:enter} Astrónoma siempre caminaba con los ojos en el cielo. {astronomer:live} Prismáticos arriba, señalando estrellas. {geologist:enter} Geólogo siempre caminaba con los ojos en el suelo. {geologist:live} Martillo dando golpecitos, mirando rocas. {rover:enter} Róver estaba taladrando cerca cuando {rover:live} vio lo que iba a pasar. {rover:pulse} Bip. Bip. ¡BIP! {sfx:bonk} ¡Bonc! Casco contra casco. {astronomer:face surprised} {geologist:face surprised} [giggles] ¡Perdón! ¡Perdón! Entonces {geologist:pulse} Geólogo señaló hacia abajo. {canvas:glints 12s} ¡Mira! El polvo brillaba. El polvo lunar está lleno de bolitas de cristal diminutas, dijo, que se formaron hace mucho cuando las rocas del espacio lo derritieron. {astronomer:face happy} {canvas:comet 14s} Astrónoma señaló hacia arriba. ¡Y mira eso! Un cometa cruzaba el cielo. {geologist:face happy} [gasps] Oooh… Así que desde entonces caminaron juntos: una mirando arriba y otro mirando abajo. {rover:hop} Y Róver, bip, bip, miraba por dónde iban.
